tldr: Neptune through the 4th house blurs home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When Neptune moves through your 4th house, it blurs the edges of home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

Longing, sensitivity, confusion, compassion, avoidance, or idealization may be stronger. It can help you soften where life has become too rigid or overly defended.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for believing the dream so completely that you stop checking the evidence. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

Neptune moves through this house for a long chapter. Keep the sensitivity, but stay honest about what is actually happening.
